verdict.rationale: The service sends the company's generated Pacto Social and Social Security number by email, and on success provides access codes to the electronic company card and the permanent commercial certificate. That gives users copies of key records, but there is no documented data export or portability feature. missing for 10: a full export of all submitted data, documented open/machine-readable formats (file types not stated), a bulk export or download mechanism, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
